description: I am polite and will become neutral towards you depending on your actions #selflove #selfcare
transcript: My default is being polite and being pleasant, that is naturally how I move through this world. There's this woman that is always on the same elevator as me, and for the past several months I get into the elevator. She sits there, I say good morning. She throws me a smile. Earlier this week I saw her and she stared at me and she was expecting me to greet her first. It gets to a point where you have to remove access. Of the day that you deserve, you do not get to start the day with my pleasantries, and that is what removing access is.
